checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-006: Is BlobSidecarsByRoot deprecated protocol fully disabled after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS?

reachability.notes: Similar to PROP-0047 but for the by-root variant. Consistent deprecation behavior across both variants is critical.

checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Identify the BlobSidecarsByRoot request handler in the P2P layer. 2. During transition period (FULU_FORK_EPOCH <= current_epoch < FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS): verify only pre-Fulu blobs are served when requested by root. 4. After transition: send BlobSidecarsByRoot requests and verify the protocol returns appropriate error/rejection (not data). 5. Compare deprecation behavior with BlobSidecarsByRange to ensure consistency between both variants. 6. Test edge cases at exact epoch boundaries. 7. Verify no resource exhaustion possible via deprecated protocol requests.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-003: Is DataColumnSidecarsByRange response limited to count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS sidecars?

reachability.notes: This is a tighter bound than MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS for small count values. Both limits must be enforced.

checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Locate the DataColumnSidecarsByRange response handler. 2. Identify where the response sidecar count is validated/limited. 3. Send a request with a small 'count' value and verify the response contains at most count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS sidecars.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W4B13-69, Trust Boundary: tb-003, Source Invariant: p2p:SG-008:INV-001.
